name: Pulled Pork or Brisket Brioche Sliders (Mild Sweet BBQ)
whyItWorks: 8-to-12-hour slow-cooked pork shoulder and beef brisket have had all their tough collagen melted into gelatin.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Trim off any hard, charred bark edges during a flare, use a smooth sweet brown-sugar BBQ sauce (zero cayenne), and serve on King's Hawaiian or brioche buns. Skip raw cabbage coleslaw.
